chapter_title: Learning Experience Design and Software Technology
title: Interaction Patterns for Learning Software
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting interaction patterns for learning software to prototype README traceability matrix connecting theory to screen changes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze how the prototype README traceability matrix connecting theory to screen changes shows a defensible decision in AIL 606.
